regime_context: Detector shows a narrowing AI-hardware leadership complex (AI Infrastructure, Memory/HBM, SemiCap) with high durability/breadth and the absolute-trend gate validated as risk control for this market. Rotation breadth is narrowing (41% eligible) but not one-narrative dominant; crowding is only a size-down caution on Cybersecurity. Momentum rank is a focus lens, not alpha.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Memory, HBM & Storage overtakes AI Infrastructure as the rotation leader (currently 0.422 score margin) — the condition that retires this watch is a sustained two-week period where Memory/HBM's score exceeds AI Infrastructure's by more than 0.2, which would mark a confirmed handoff of leadership within the same AI-hardware complex.

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: Highest-momentum theme with 'trend' hurst tag (cleanest trend-health among top ranks), durable breadth (0.75), non-crowded (z=0.15), and gate-eligible. Within the dominant AI-hardware complex, this is the challenger with the strongest trend-health signature — a focus emphasis rather than a leader-fade.
theses.dissent: Cross-sectional momentum rank-IC ~0 means the ranking itself carries no forward return edge; HBM is a crowded AI narrative and any supply-chain demand miss (e.g. hyperscaler capex guide-down) hits this single-commodity group hardest.

falsifier.text: Memory/HBM proxy lags AI Infrastructure proxy by 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: Confirmed leader with highest score (2.295), strong durability (0.71) and high breadth (0.875), non-crowded. Guardrail permits naming the prevailing narrative and judging its durability, which remains intact by breadth/cohesion. Lean is a continuation of the dominant complex, not a crowding-flag fade.
evidence: rotation leader with margin 0.422 over challenger
theses.dissent: Headline val_state 'fading' and hurst 'mixed' suggest leader momentum is maturing; if the challenger (Memory/HBM) takes leadership, AI Infra could lag while still rising absolutely.

falsifier.text: AI Infrastructure proxy lags S&P 500 by 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: The only non-AI theme in the top tier that is gate-eligible with a clean 'trend' hurst tag and non-zero breadth (0.545); offers theme-complex diversification while staying inside the validated trend gate. Mildly crowded-free (z=0.76).
theses.dissent: Energy breadth (0.545) is thin and the macro backdrop flags geopolitical headlines; energy is mean-reverting at the tail and a sudden risk-off would crush this late-cycle complex.

falsifier.text: XLE lags S&P 500 by 8% before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
